chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever sends ahead a child, it is better for him than leaving behind seventy after him, all of whom had ridden horses and fought in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.خَيْرًا: better; more beneficial in spiritual outcome
key_terms.رَكِبَ الْخَيْلَ: rode horses; an expression of martial readiness
key_terms.قَاتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: fought in the way of Allah
key_terms.قَدَّمَ: sent ahead; a figurative expression for a child preceding the parent in death
key_terms.يُخَلِّفُهُمْ: he leaves them behind after himself

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the spiritual merit of losing a child?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that the death of a child before one's own passing can carry immense spiritual reward and benefit for the parent. It consoles the bereaved by stating that such a loss may be better for them than leaving behind many children who grow up to perform even great outward deeds.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.519 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever loses a child (before their own passing), it is better for them than leaving behind seventy children after them, all of whom rode horses and fought in the way of Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious."
